questions.stem: Which of the following is classified as a component of the capital account?
choices: Foreign Direct Investments
Trade in goods
Imports of services
Receipts from exports
questions.solution: The capital account records international transactions of assets, and one of its components is Foreign Direct Investments. Trade in goods and receipts from exports are part of the current account, while imports of services are also part of the current account. Therefore, the correct answer is Foreign Direct Investments.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा पूंजी खाते के घटक के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?

hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi terminology used for economic concepts.

mr.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, technical terms are appropriately used in Marathi.

questions.stem: What is the meaning of 'net invisibles' in the context of the current account?
choices: Total exports of goods
Total imports of goods
Difference between exports and imports of services
Difference between exports and imports of goods
questions.solution: Net invisibles refers to the difference between the value of exports and imports of services, which is a key component of the current account. This option correctly captures the concept, while the others refer to goods or total exports/imports, which do not align with the definition of net invisibles.

hi.stem: वर्तमान खाते के संदर्भ में 'शुद्ध अदृश्य' का अर्थ क्या है?

hi.solution: शुद्ध अदृश्य सेवाओं के निर्यात और आयात के मूल्य के बीच अंतर को कहते हैं, जो वर्तमान खाते का एक महत्वपूर्ण घटक है। इस विकल्प में अवधारणा सही ढंग से दर्शाई गई है, जबकि अन्य विकल्प माल या कुल निर्यात/आयात को दर्शाते हैं, जो शुद्ध अदृश्य के परिभाषा से मेल नहीं खाते।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, technical terms are appropriate for Hindi-medium curriculum.

mr.solution: नेट अनदृश्य सेवांच्या निर्यात आणि आयात दरम्यानच्या मूल्याच्या फरकाला संदर्भित करते, जे करंट अकाउंटचा महत्वाचा घटक आहे. हा विकल्प संकल्पनेच्या योग्य व्याख्येला प्रतिबिंबित करतो, तर इतर विकल्प मालाच्या एकूण निर्यात/आयात वर आधारित आहेत, जे नेट अनदृश्य च्या व्याख्येशी जुळत नाहीत.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the 'errors and omissions' entry in the balance of payments?
choices: To record all international transactions accurately
To reflect the difference between current and capital accounts
To account for unrecorded or unmeasured transactions
To show the net flow of capital into the country
questions.solution: The 'errors and omissions' entry in the balance of payments is used to account for transactions that were not recorded or could not be measured accurately. This makes the correct option the one that states it addresses unrecorded or unmeasured transactions. The other options are incorrect because the entry does not aim to record all transactions, nor does it directly reflect the difference between accounts or show the net flow of capital.

questions.stem: Under a fixed exchange rate system, what must the government do if there is a deficit in the balance of payments?
choices: Maintain large stocks of foreign exchange reserves
Allow the market to determine the exchange rate
Reduce the interest rate
Increase the money supply
questions.solution: The government must intervene to take care of the gap by using its official reserves. This is because under a fixed exchange rate system, the government is committed to maintaining the exchange rate at a specific level. If it fails to do so, it may lead to a loss of confidence and speculation. The other options are not correct because they describe features of a flexible exchange rate system or other economic policies.

questions.stem: What is the role of official reserve transactions in the balance of payments?
choices: They are used to determine the exchange rate
They are the difference between autonomous and accommodating transactions
They are used to finance a current account deficit
They are the sum of the current account and capital account
questions.solution: Official reserve transactions are used to finance a current account deficit by adjusting the reserves of a country. They play a critical role in maintaining balance in the balance of payments. The other options are incorrect because they do not accurately describe the role of official reserve transactions.

questions.stem: If an Indian company sells shares to a Chinese investor, how is this treated in the capital account?
choices: As a debit item
As a credit item
As a surplus item
As a deficit item
questions.solution: When an Indian company sells shares to a Chinese investor, it represents an inflow of foreign capital into the country, which is recorded as a credit item in the capital account. A debit item would occur if the company were purchasing assets from abroad. Surplus and deficit refer to the overall balance of payments, not individual transactions.

questions.stem: If the marginal propensity to consume (c) is 0.8 and the marginal propensity to import (m) is 0.3, what is the value of the open economy multiplier?
questions.solution: The open economy multiplier is calculated as 1 / (1 – c + m). Substituting c = 0.8 and m = 0.3, we get 1 / (1 – 0.8 + 0.3) = 1 / 0.5 = 2. Therefore, the open economy multiplier is 2.

mr.solution: एका देशाचा दुसऱ्या देशांना उत्तरदायी असणे असे दर्शवते की तो आंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापारातून खर्चापेक्षा जास्त कमाई करतो, जे वर्तमान खात्याच्या उत्पादनाचे द्योतक आहे. इतर विकल्प चुकीचे आहेत कारण उत्पादन आर्थिक कमजोरीचा इशारा देत नाही, देश उधार घेत नाही आणि वस्तू आणि सेवांच्या समान विनिमयाचे आवश्यकता नाही.

questions.stem: If a country has a fixed exchange rate and experiences a current account deficit, what is the likely impact on its foreign exchange reserves?
choices: They will increase
They will decrease
They will remain unchanged
They will be converted into gold
questions.solution: In a fixed exchange rate system, if there is a current account deficit, the government must use its foreign exchange reserves to maintain the exchange rate. This leads to a decrease in the reserves. The other options are incorrect because they describe scenarios that do not align with the mechanics of a fixed exchange rate system.

hi.stem: यदि किसी देश के पास निर्धारित विनिमय दर है और उसे वर्तमान खाता घाटा होता है, तो इसके विदेशी पूंजी भंडार पर संभावित प्रभाव क्या होगा?
choices: उनकी बढ़ जाएगी
उनकी घट जाएगी
उनकी अपरिवर्तित रहेगी
उन्हें सोने में परिवर्तित कर दिया जाएगा
hi.solution: निर्धारित विनिमय दर प्रणाली में, यदि वर्तमान खाता घाटा होता है, तो सरकार को विनिमय दर बनाए रखने के लिए अपने विदेशी पूंजी भंडार का उपयोग करना पड़ता है। इससे भंडार में कमी आती है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे निर्धारित विनिमय दर प्रणाली के यांत्रिकी के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।
hi.critique: Translation accurately preserves meaning, technical terms match Indian curriculum usage, and the correct answer remains option 2 (decrease) in Hindi.

mr.stem: एका देशाचा निश्चित विनिमय दर असेल आणि त्याला वर्तमान खाता अवमूल्यन अनुभव होईल, तर त्याच्या विदेशी विनिमय निधीवर अपेक्षित परिणाम काय असेल?
choices: त्यांची वाढ होईल
त्यांची घट होईल
त्यांची बदलत नाही
त्यांना सोन्यामध्ये बदलले जाईल
mr.solution: निश्चित विनिमय दराच्या पद्धतीत, जर वर्तमान खाता अवमूल्यन असेल, तर सरकारने विनिमय दर बरोबर ठेवण्यासाठी त्याच्या विदेशी विनिमय निधीचा वापर करावा लागेल. यामुळे निधीत घट होते. इतर विकल्प अयोग्य आहेत कारण ते निश्चित विनिमय दराच्या पद्धतीच्या यंत्रणेशी संरेखित नाहीत.
